This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - This is an AI Research Director (PI) session for project `symb_invariant_consensus`, targeting EMNLP 2026 ARR May 25 submission (5 days away)
   - Session started with service restart recovery — all conversation memory was lost
   - Primary goal: manage the transition from exhaustive experimentation (25+ methods all negative) to paper writing sprint
   - Core research finding: Independence Bottleneck in LLM symbolic consensus aggregation, rooted in Symbolic Confirmation Bias (4.97× bias ratio)
   - Key tension discovered mid-session: previous Director session made D087 (revoke experiment lock for Direction R DeBERTa external verifier), which conflicts with my D085 (experiment lock + writing sprint)
   - User (研究顾问曹晓玉) wants a positive method contribution to avoid "interesting analysis but no positive method" rejection — Direction R (DeBERTa cross-architecture verifier) is the candidate

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **SICA**: Symbolic Invariant Consensus Aggregation — MAX-SAT over FOL constraints extracted from LLM reasoning traces
   - **Independence Bottleneck**: Same-model LLM traces are highly correlated (Fleiss' κ=0.21-0.82, Eff-K=1.2-3.6 vs nominal K=12)
   - **Symbolic Confirmation Bias**: Self-extracted FOL constraints systematically confirm trace's own answer (bias ratio 4.97× on incorrect problems, 94% SICA errors overlap with SC errors)
   - **Process-κ**: New metric — CoT cosine similarity (0.69) >> answer-κ (0.41), r=-0.06, only 9.3% convergent trace pairs
   - **Independence-Accuracy Trade-off**: Debate κ 0.44→0.15 but accuracy -18.6pp (capstone finding)
   - **Oracle Gap**: Gold FOL + MAX-SAT = +14.22pp (p<0.001), self-extraction only 24% utilization
   - **Condorcet Jury Theorem (CJT)**: Theoretical framework — requires voter independence + accuracy >0.5
   - **Eff-K formula**: K/(1+(K-1)κ) — effective independent trace count
   - **Direction R (DeBERTa)**: Cross-architecture external verifier using DeBERTa-large-mnli (encoder-only + NLI fine-tuned) on FOLIO-204 (NLI task)
   - **25+ interventions tested**: prompt engineering, method-level redesign (ICG/Contrastive/Debate), solver modifications, cross-model aggregation, code verification (PROVE), iterative refinement (CEGIS), blind FOL, adversarial negation, etc. — ALL negative
   - **Wave 1/2/3 structure**: Parallel exploration waves attacking different aspects of the bottleneck
   - **D085 vs D087 conflict**: D085 locked experiments for writing; D087 (from previous session, based on user input) revoked lock for R/S/Q experiments

D002\\n- id: D004\\n  date: 2026-05-15 12:02 UTC\\n  summary: MVP T=0.7 继续跑完（需要完整数据），diagnostic 自然结束后 GPU 带宽恢复；AIME 30 题排在 MVP 之后\\n  rationale: Temperature 诊断 4/5 题显示 T=0.7/0.9/1.0 均几乎不产生答案分歧——C2/C3 高风险 FAIL。但仍决定让\\n    MVP 跑完：(1) 50 题完整数据无论正负都有价值（负面结果=SICA 在强模型上无信号，本身是发现）；(2) GPU 已分配且无其他实验排队；(3)\\n    smoke test L5 有 3 条矛盾，50 题中 L4-5 有 20 题可能产生更多信号。MVP 完成后立即跑 AIME 30 题（QwQ-32B ~79.5%，分歧应更明显），作为\\\"高难度\\n    sweet spot\\\"的补充验证。如果 MATH+AIME 均 SICA≈SC → 准备 FAIL 路径决策。\\n  related_experiments: []\\n  depends_on:\\n  - D003\\n- id: D005\\n  date: 2026-05-15 12:16 UTC\\n  summary: 'D005: 采用双管齐下方案——MATH-500 MVP 继续 + AIME 30 题紧跟，暂不换模型'\\n  rationale: Temperature 诊断确认 QwQ-32B 在 T=0.7/0.9/1.0 下均产生近零答案分歧——reasoning model\\n    的确定性推理压制采样随机性。MATH-500 MVP 高概率 FAIL on C2/C3，但数据仍有价值（负面结果本身有意义）。AIME 2024 是 QwQ-32B\\n    弱项（~79.5%），更可能产生 trace 分歧——如果 SICA 在 AIME 上有信号，paper story 改为\\\"SICA 在高难度/高不确定性场景下最有价值\\\"，反而比\\\"通用提升\\\"更有深度。模型切换（Qwen2.5-7B\\n    等）改变论文定位太大，留作 AIME 也失败后的最后手段。执行顺序：MATH MVP 跑完 → AIME 30 题 → 基于两组结果做 PASS/FAIL\\n    最终判定。\\n  related_experiments: []\\n  depends_on:\\n  - D004\\n- id: D006\\n  date: 2026-05-15 12:19 UTC\\n  summary: 'D006: Kill 当前 MATH MVP（有 bug + 25-30h 不可接受），修 bug 后 AIME 30 题优先'\\n  rationale: D005 假设 MVP 4-7h 出结果，但实际第一题 20min+ 未完成（serial trace gen + extraction\\n    回归 5/12 JSON parse fail），外推 25-30h。加上多样性诊断已定论（零分歧），继续烧 25-30h GPU 等一个几乎确定 FAIL\\n    的结果不合理。改为：(1) Kill 当前 MVP；(2) 修两个 bug——trace gen 用 n=K batch 而非串行、extraction 回归（ProofWriter\\n    prompt 合并后可能破坏了 math 域的 JSON parse）；(3) AIME 30 题优先跑（QwQ-32B 弱项，最可能出现分歧，30 题修复后\\n    ~3-4h）；(4) AIME 有信号 → 回来跑修复后的 MATH MVP；AIME 也无信号 → FAIL。\\n  related_experiments: []\\n  depends_on:\\n  - D005\\n- id: D007\\n  date: 2026-05-15 16:31 UTC\\n  summary: 'D007: z3 parser 是 0pp 差距根因——并行修 parser + scorer，v3 继续跑后批量重打分'\\n  rationale: '7/30 题 Reviewer 分析发现 parse_z3_formula() 损失率 41-100%（P7: 72→1, 98.6%），LLM\\n    提取的约束在 z3 转换时被大量丢弃，MAX-SAT 无法工作。P7（SC 1/12 极度分散）是 SICA 理论最佳场景但因 parser 失效无法发挥。策略：v3\\n    继续跑收集全部 traces（最贵部分），并行修 parser + scorer，30 题完成后批量重打分作为真正 MVP 结果。'\\n  related_experiments:\\n  - exp_id: sica_aime30_v3\\n    role: 数据来源\\n    result: 11/30 done, SICA=SC=63.6%, 0pp\\n  depends_on:\\n  - D007\\n- id: D009\\n  date: 2026-05-15 17:53 UTC\\n  summary: 'D009: max_tokens=10240 截断是 0-vote 根因，修为 16384 + fallback extraction +\\n    save intermediates，v3 完成后 v4 重跑截断题'\\n  rationale: P8/P9/P11 的 0/12 答案提取全因 trace 在 10240 tokens 截断，\\\\boxed{} 未生成。P11 有 60\\n    raw constraints（11/12 提取成功）证明模型推理充分但 token 不够。trace 耗时与截断强相关：350-435s→12/12 votes,\\n    730-810s→0-1/12 votes。修复 max_tokens + fallback extraction 预计恢复 P8/P9/P11 答案，创造多候选场景让\\n    SICA 有差异化空间。v3 继续跑（非截断题有效），v4 只重跑截断题，合并为最终 MVP。\\n  related_experiments:\\n  - exp_id: sica_aime30_v3\\n    role: 数据来源\\n    result: 12/30 done, P8/P9/P11 confirmed truncated at 10240 tokens\\n  depends_on:\\n  - D008\\n- id: D010\\n  date: 2026-05-15 19:11 UTC\\n  summary: 'D010: AIME 0pp gap 是结构性的——QwQ-32B 单候选主导，SICA≡SC。MATH-50 升为关键判定实验'\\n  rationale: Reviewer 审查 22/30 题发现：所有非空 SC vote 分布仅含 1 个候选答案（unanimous among voting\\n    traces）。SICA 只能在多候选竞争时产生差异，单候选场景下无论约束打分如何都选同一答案。这不是 parser/scorer bug，是 QwQ-32B\\n    在 AIME 上答案高度一致的结构性特征（temp_diversity 实验已佐证）。v4 修复 max_tokens+fallback 可能恢复截断题的答案，但如果恢复的仍是同一答案则\\n    0pp 不变。MATH-500 Level 1-5 混合难度可能存在更多答案多样性（模型错误率 ~9.4%，错题上不同 trace 可能给出不同错答案），是验证\\n    SICA 核心假设的关键实验。调整优先级：v3 完成 → vote diversity 分析 → v4 快速验证 → MATH-50（决定性实验）。\\n  related_experiments:\\n  -
